title: One ShieldCare Plan for One Covered Item
content:
## The charter on multiple holdings

A customer may hold as many Northbeam ShieldCare Protection Plans as they have items to
cover, and the number of plans on one profile is not limited. A second plan is never opened on
an item whose serial already carries a plan standing as an application received, active, or
held while a claim is under review. Where the customer wants better cover on an item already
covered, the plan on file is cancelled under the cancellation rules and the new plan is sold
afresh; the two are never run side by side. A ShieldCare Business Fleet Protection plan
carries several serials on one plan record up to its item slots, and each serial still counts
as covered only once.

## The condition on a second plan, stated as a condition

The object the condition is tested against is the serial of the item to be covered. The plan
records on file are the authority for it, tested before the sale is written; what the customer
says about the cover they believe they hold is not that authority. A plan standing on the same
serial counts against the sale when it stands as an application received, when it is active,
or when it is held while a claim is under review, and it counts whatever day it was purchased
on and whichever plan it is. A plan on that serial standing expired, cancelled or void does
not count against the sale.

## Two readings of the same charter

| Question of fact | The charter's answer |
| --- | --- |
| The profile already holds five plans on five different items | A sixth plan may be opened; the count on a profile is not limited |
| The serial already carries an active plan | No second plan is opened on that serial |
| The serial carries a cancelled plan alone | A plan may be opened on that serial |
| The customer wants richer cover on an item already covered | The plan on file is cancelled under the cancellation rules and a new plan is sold afresh |
| A fleet record already carries the serial in one of its slots | That serial is covered once, and not again |

## A case on hypothetical records

A household profile carries a ShieldCare Accidental Damage Plus plan standing active on a
tablet, and a ShieldCare Essential Parts and Labour plan standing cancelled on a kettle. A
plan may be opened on the kettle, because the only plan on that serial stands cancelled. No
second plan is opened on the tablet, because the plan on that serial stands active; richer
cover on the tablet is reached by cancelling the plan on file and selling the new plan
afresh, never by running both.
